dict.string: Conteur listens while you tell your story so it can give you feedback on how you told it. Your recordings stay on this iPhone.

Conteur watches your expressions while you speak, shows you how your face is reading, and tells you where your delivery came alive and where it went flat. Nothing is recorded — no video is ever saved or sent anywhere.
Conteur turns your retelling into text on this iPhone so it can point to the exact moments it is giving you feedback about.
